title: RunRecord
description: The stored result of one seeded run: metrics plus everything needed to reproduce it, not every frame. The metrics shape is filled in during Phase 1. scenario is a full copy of the scenario as it was run (it includes the seed).

origin.description: 'job' runs were computed by the backend and are trusted; 'clientReported' runs were uploaded from a browser.

venueHash.description: Hash of the venue geometry the run used, so comparisons can tell whether runs share a venue.

parameters.description: The full resolved parameter set (defaults plus overrides) the run used.

metrics.description: Run metrics (spec section 4.5). Structure defined in Phase 1.

metricsHash.description: Hash of the canonical Float64 dump of the metrics (determinism check).
